# Mailbox fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

These `.eml` files are NOT real platform mails. They are hand-built from the documented/typical structure of each
platform's saved-search alert (sender domain, subject, an HTML table/list of offers with a link, title and price).
Replace them with real alert mails once the alert mailbox exists, and adjust `dh/sources/mailbox.py` parsers if the
real structure differs. Addresses and ids are made up.
